title: Niglisar
summary: Raleigh names Niglisar in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Niglisar, also printed Niriglissoroor and Niglissar, whom Berosus makes the sisters husband of Euilmerodach, and who held the kingdome after him. Scaliger shifts this man in as Protector. He was not equated with Reg-Assar. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
